plan: Given my private value of $21, I will aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit if I win. Bidding $20.9 is optimal since it is the maximum non-dominated bid, ensuring profit if I win and the second-highest bid is below $20.9. This bid minimizes the risk of overpaying relative to my value and maximizes potential profit.

Given my value of $27, I will bid just below this to maximize potential profit while minimizing loss. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid $26.9. This bid ensures I can win against most bids below my value, maximizing profit, while still paying less than my value if I win. This strategy balances winning chances and profit margins, considering the second-highest bid determines my cost.

To maximize profit, I should bid just above the estimated second-highest bid but below my value. With a value of $14, bidding too high risks low or negative profit if I win. Assuming others value similarly, a bid slightly above half of $14 could be competitive. Bids above $14 are dominated, as they risk a loss. I'll bid $10 to balance winning chances and profit potential.
